headline: Two oil tankers suffer explosions from mines in Hormuz and one sinks
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said both ships were sailing on unauthorized routes with identification systems switched off. No possible casualties have been reported.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and shipping insurance costs.
why_moved: Explosions on two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raise concern about disruption to Gulf oil shipments, which tends to lift crude prices.
